currentTransformation.nextDecision: Inspect gameplay-source 61c2a19b matched normal-speed desktop/portrait action if evidence workflow 41333042597 completes, including boss charge/blocked route, three canyon layers and simplified distant citadel depth. The CI run 41333042615 failed 1/693 due a stale pre-encounter 20.5% actor-framing ceiling; the 24% updated bound and new guardian pose/framing test are committed after this source but not yet fully verified. currentTransformation.rejectedMicroMilestones: A green CI run, an isolated pose fix, a prettier screenshot or an extra UI icon never counts as a Gauntlet win.

Older WebGL software renderer shows very long candidate submission tails; lower-detail far-field and stronger source-timed combat choreography are real source changes but have not been shown superior at normal speed. Frozen baseline terminal observation and independent judgments remain missing.
